name: Univers-Cité des mathématiques

learning.projection_authority: UCKK owns pedagogical selection/topology; MathKristal owns mathematical knowledge.
learning.pathways: derived from pinned MathKristal pedagogical paths
learning.courses: derived projected course steps; counts are not architectural constants
learning.page_specs: one semantic page specification per projected course step in the current projection
learning.moodle_materialization: derived surfaces may be rebuilt idempotently; human/transactional state must be preserved

mediatheque.semantic_binding: projected course/page source_refs resolve to MathKristal provenance and Source Store; legacy concept_refs remain compatibility only

integration_invariants: MathKristal is the epistemic/reference authority for mathematical referents, assertions, proofs, dependencies and provenance.
UCKK owns pedagogical selection and topology: pathways, projected course steps, page specifications and materialization policy.
A pedagogical path is a consumer projection and never alters logical proof dependencies in MathKristal.
SemantiK Architect articulates already-selected communication obligations; it does not select mathematical content or curriculum.
Only RELEASED SemantiK Architect language/profile RuntimeSets may produce canonical multilingual page artifacts.
The canonical page-serving path does not require an LLM at runtime; AI may assist authoring, enrichment or tutoring outside the deterministic projection/render path.
Moodle owns live media, permissions, enrolments, grades, submissions, annotations and other human/transactional state.
Projection rebuilds must be idempotent for derived surfaces and must never overwrite human/transactional Moodle state.
The historical MATH-CURRICULUM-2.0 registry remains readable for compatibility but is no longer the knowledge authority or public Math navigation source.
Former Math pathway identifiers remain migration-only; new projected knowledge identities use the MathKristal-backed projection and stable URNs.
The mathematical library remains an autonomous fund; MathKristal is referenced as a pinned corpus and page/course links use source provenance rather than duplicated epistemic ownership.

rendering.language_policy: serve only RELEASED language/profile RuntimeSets; no silent fallback
rendering.multilingual_model: realize the same semantic page spec independently in each admitted target language; do not translate through a pivot language
